notes: Official Pathway Connectivity (Acuity Brands) user manual, dated 08/27/21, obtained via the Wayback Machine archive of img.acuitybrands.com (the live acuitybrands.com/pathwayconnect.com domains return HTTP 403 via Cloudflare bot protection to non-browser fetches; content is the manufacturer's original PDF, unaltered). All device I/O is via removable screw/terminal-block connectors (no true XLR or circular connectors are fitted, though the DMX terminal maps 1:1 to standard XLR5 pinout: 1=Common/Shield, 2=Data-, 3=Data+, 4/5=unused). No connector in the provided list is an exact match for a DMX screw terminal, so "euroblock" was used for the signal (DMX) terminals and "euroblock-dc" for the power terminal, per the closest-match instruction. No bandwidth grade applies (DMX512 terminals and DC power are not in the graded connector list). This is a DIN-rail mounted module (0.5 lb, 4.5"x4"x1.85"), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Device is a passive DMX512 signal repeater/isolator/splitter (1 input, optional daisy-chain thru, 4 isolated outputs) rather than a classic AV extender; "Extender" was chosen as the closest fit in the given type enum, and "control" as the closest category (lighting control signal distribution). A companion "RDM" variant of this product exists (PWREP-DIN-P4 without NONRDM suffix) which supports RDM pass-through — not covered here.

ports.name: DMX IN
ports.note: 6-position screw terminal: SHLD/COM, D1-, D1+, D2- (unused), D2+ (unused). Corresponds to XLR5 pins 1-3 (D2 pins unused/spare).

ports.name: DMX THRU
ports.note: Screw-terminal daisy-chain feed carrying the DMX IN signal onward to the next module's DMX IN; DMX Terminate switch must be OFF if used.

ports.name: DMX OUT 1
ports.note: Isolated (1500V) repeated DMX output, screw terminal.

ports.name: DMX OUT 2
ports.note: Isolated (1500V) repeated DMX output, screw terminal.

ports.name: DMX OUT 3
ports.note: Isolated (1500V) repeated DMX output, screw terminal.

ports.name: DMX OUT 4
ports.note: Isolated (1500V) repeated DMX output, screw terminal.

ports.name: POWER IN
ports.note: Removable screw-terminal block: V+, V-, GND, EARTH GROUND, 9-30VDC @ 500mA (6W). A second V+/V- pair on the same terminal block allows power daisy-chaining to other DIN modules.
